tagline: Top rated Bankruptcy attorney in Chicago, Illinois

about: Howard L. Adelman is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2005 - 2027. He works at Adelman & Gettleman, Ltd., located in Chicago, Illinois, and provides legal services for issues involving Bankruptcy: Business and Business Litigation to the surrounding community.
Howard Adelman completed legal studies at Saint Louis University School of Law and graduated with the class of 1977. Howard Adelman passed the bar in 1977.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
